khmer: មុខរបរ
breakdown: 职(duty, post)+业(work) — your line of work

examples.py: Yīshēng shì hěn hǎo de zhíyè.

examples.en: Consider your interests when choosing a career.

khmer: រុក្ខជាតិ
breakdown: 植(to plant, 木wood radical)+物(thing) — a planted thing

examples.py: Wǒ jiā lǐ yǒu hěn duō zhíwù.
examples.en: There are many plants in my home.

examples.py: Sēnlín lǐ yǒu hěn duō zhíwù.
examples.en: There are many plants in the forest.

examples.py: Zhè zhǒng zhíwù hěn shǎo jiàn.
examples.en: This kind of plant is rare.

english: to have no choice but to
khmer: ចាំបាច់ត្រូវ
breakdown: 只(only)+好(good, okay) — the only okay option left

examples.py: Xià yǔ le, wǒ zhǐhǎo huí jiā.
examples.en: It rained, so I had to go home.
No tickets, so we had to walk.

examples.cn: 他不来，我只好一个人去。
examples.py: Tā bù lái, wǒ zhǐhǎo yí ge rén qù.
examples.en: He isn't coming, so I have to go alone.

examples.py: Qián bú gòu, zhǐhǎo xuǎn piányi de.
examples.en: Not enough money, so I had to choose the cheap one.

examples.py: Diànnǎo huài le, zhǐhǎo yòng shǒujī.
examples.en: The computer broke, so I had to use my phone.

english: as long as; so long as
khmer: គ្រាន់តែ
breakdown: 只(only)+要(need) — you only need this much

examples.en: As long as you try, you'll succeed.

examples.py: Zhǐyào nǐ lái, wǒ jiù gāoxìng.
examples.en: As long as you come, I'm happy.

examples.py: Zhǐyào yǒu shíjiān, wǒ jiù yuèdú.
examples.en: Whenever I have time, I read.
As long as you persist, there will be results.

examples.cn: 只要不下雨，我们就出发。
examples.py: Zhǐyào bú xià yǔ, wǒmen jiù chūfā.
examples.en: As long as it doesn't rain, we'll set off.

khmer: ចង្អុល / ម្រាមដៃ
breakdown: 扌(hand radical)+旨 — the hand that points

examples.en: He is pointing in that direction.

examples.py: Qǐng bié yòng shǒu zhǐ zhe biéren.
Tā zhǐ chū le wǒ de cuòwù.
Zhège cí zhǐ de shì shénme?
examples.en: What does this word refer to?

khmer: យ៉ាងហោចណាស់
breakdown: 至(reach, extreme)+少(few) — at the fewest

examples.en: It takes at least three days.
There are at least a hundred people.
Practice at least half an hour daily.
This is worth at least a thousand yuan.

khmer: គុណភាព
breakdown: 质(substance, nature)+量(amount) — the nature and measure of a thing

examples.en: Customers are satisfied with the quality.
This quality isn't up to standard.

khmer: ចំណុចសំខាន់
breakdown: 重(heavy, important)+点(point) — the important point

examples.en: This is the exam's key point.
The teacher explained the key points.
When reviewing, grasp the key points.

examples.cn: 这篇文章的重点在最后。
examples.py: Zhè piān wénzhāng de zhòngdiǎn zài zuìhòu.
examples.en: This article's key point is at the end.

english: to value; to attach importance to
khmer: យកចិត្តទុកដាក់ខ្ពស់
breakdown: 重(heavy, important)+视(view) — viewing it as important

examples.cn: 这个问题没有受到重视。

khmer: ជុំវិញ
breakdown: 周(circle, week)+围(surround) — the circle around you

examples.py: Xuéxiào zhōuwéi yǒu hěn duō shāngdiàn.
examples.en: There are many shops around the school.

examples.py: Zhōuwéi de rén dōu zài bāngmáng.
examples.en: The people around are all helping.

khmer: គំនិត
breakdown: 主(main)+意(idea) — your main idea

khmer: អបអរសាទរ
breakdown: 祝(wish)+贺(congratulate) — wishing and congratulating

examples.py: Wǒ shōu dào le hěn duō zhùhè.

khmer: ល្បីល្បាញ
breakdown: 著(notable)+名(name) — a notable name

examples.en: The Great Wall is a famous place.

examples.py: Zhè shì yí bù zhùmíng de xiǎoshuō.

examples.cn: 这个城市因为小吃著名。
examples.en: This city is famous for its snacks.

khmer: ដោយឡែក / ជំនាញ
breakdown: 专(focused)+门(door, field) — focused on one field

examples.en: I came specially to see you.

examples.py: Zhè jiā diàn zhuānmén mài chá.
Wǒ zhuānmén wèi nǐ zhǔnbèi de.
examples.en: I prepared this specially for you.

khmer: ជំនាញ
breakdown: 专(focused)+业(field of work) — your focused field

examples.py: Wǒ de zhuānyè shì ruǎnjiàn gōngchéng.

examples.en: Consider the future when choosing a major.

khmer: បត់ / ផ្ទេរ
breakdown: 车(vehicle radical)+专 — wheels turning

examples.py: Qǐng bǎ zhè fēng xìn zhuǎn gěi tā.
examples.en: Please pass this letter on to him.

examples.py: Wǒ zhuǎn dào le lìng yí ge zhuānyè.

khmer: រកប្រាក់
breakdown: 贝(shell, money radical)+兼 — the money radical shows the meaning

examples.py: Tā zhuàn le hěn duō qián.
examples.en: He earned a lot of money.

examples.py: Zhège gōngzuò zhuàn de bù duō.
Tā yìbiān xuéxí yìbiān zhuàn qián.

khmer: ត្រឹមត្រូវច្បាស់លាស់
breakdown: 准(accurate)+确(certain) — accurate and certain

examples.en: We should be slow yet accurate.

examples.py: Qǐng gěi wǒ zhǔnquè de xìnxī.

khmer: ទាន់ពេលវេលា
breakdown: 准(exact)+时(time) — exactly on time

examples.py: Tā měi cì dōu hěn zhǔnshí.

examples.en: The plane took off on time.
Punctuality is a form of politeness.

khmer: ដោយប្រុងប្រយ័ត្ន
breakdown: 仔(careful, 亻person radical)+细(fine, thin) — attending to fine detail

examples.py: Zǐxì de rén bù róngyì chū cuò.

examples.en: Please listen carefully to the instructions.

khmer: ធម្មជាតិ
breakdown: 自(self)+然(so) — being so by itself

khmer: ទំនុកចិត្តលើខ្លួនឯង
breakdown: 自(self)+信(believe) — believing in yourself

examples.en: Be a bit more confident in yourself.

examples.py: Tā zìxìn de huídá le wèntí.

khmer: សេចក្ដីសង្ខេប
breakdown: 总(overall)+结(tie up) — tying it all together

examples.py: Tā zǒngjié le zhè cì de jīngyàn.

examples.en: You write a summary at term's end.

examples.cn: 总结失败的原因很重要。
examples.py: Zǒngjié shībài de yuányīn hěn zhòngyào.

khmer: ជួល
breakdown: 禾(grain radical)+且 — rent was once paid in grain

examples.py: Wǒ zū le yí ge fángzi.

examples.en: How much is the monthly rent?
The landlord came to collect rent.

examples.py: Zū fángzi bǐ mǎi fángzi piányi.

khmer: ល្អបំផុត / គួរតែ
breakdown: 最(most)+好(good) — the most good

examples.py: Zhè shì zuì hǎo de fāngfǎ.
Nǐ zuì hǎo zǎo diǎn xiūxi.
Tā shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péngyou.

examples.en: It's best to prepare in advance.

examples.py: Zuì hǎo bié zài zhèlǐ tíngchē.

khmer: គោរព
breakdown: 尊(honor)+重(value highly) — honoring and valuing

khmer: ប្រហែល
breakdown: 左(left)+右(right) — a little to either side, so 'about'

examples.en: He is about thirty years old.
The price is around a hundred yuan.
Please look both left and right.

khmer: អ្នកនិពន្ធ
breakdown: 作(create, write)+家(expert, master) — a master of writing

examples.en: I want to be a writer.

examples.cn: 这位作家写了很多小说。
examples.py: Zhè wèi zuòjiā xiě le hěn duō xiǎoshuō.

examples.en: Writers need a lot of reading.

examples.py: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan de zuòjiā shì tā.

khmer: តួនាទី / ឥទ្ធិពល
breakdown: 作(act)+用(use) — how something acts and is used

examples.en: What effect does this medicine have?

examples.py: Tā qǐ le hěn dà de zuòyòng.

examples.cn: 练习对提高水平有作用。
examples.py: Liànxí duì tígāo shuǐpíng yǒu zuòyòng.
examples.en: Practice has an effect on raising your level.

khmer: អ្នកនិពន្ធ (អត្ថបទ)
breakdown: 作(write, create)+者(person) — the person who wrote it

examples.py: Zhè běn shū de zuòzhě shì shéi?
examples.en: Who is the author of this book?

examples.cn: 作者的名字在最后一页。
examples.py: Zuòzhě de míngzi zài zuìhòu yí yè.
examples.en: The author's name is on the last page.

examples.cn: 这篇文章的作者是教授。
examples.py: Zhè piān wénzhāng de zuòzhě shì jiàoshòu.
examples.en: The author of this article is a professor.

khmer: កន្លែងអង្គុយ
breakdown: 广(shelter)+two 人(people)+土(earth) — people seated under a roof

khmer: កៅអី / កន្លែងអង្គុយ
breakdown: 座(seat)+位(position) — the position where you sit

examples.en: My seat is at the front.
The seat number is on the boarding pass.
Please give your seat to elderly people.

examples.py: Wǒ zài cāntīng yùdìng le zuòwèi.
examples.en: I reserved a seat at the restaurant.
